title: Vertical proper/open transport pasting
statement: For supplied operations, compositors and open comparisons [def-sf-integral-system-operations], a canonical bridge, and a proper/open gamma satisfying the canonical bridge equation of ProperOpenCoherence [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data], the vertical pasting equation holds. The comparison is with the intrinsic semilinear gamma [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting].

source.place: Pasting equations for transported proper/open gamma

proof.text: Postcompose by the target bridge and direct-image compositor isomorphisms. Use the canonical gamma equations for the two squares and their composite. The bridge compositor equation identifies the direct-image compositions. Naturality moves the open and direct bridge factors to the endpoints; the intrinsic vertical pasting equation identifies the remaining composites. Cancel the target isomorphism.

source.place: Proper/open pasting for the canonical transported gamma; compatibility of the direct-image compositors (Stacks 03D8, 07A7).

proof_origin.place: Canonical bridge transport; explicit naturality and inverse cancellation, with compositor comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemProperOpenTransportPastingVertical
    (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (_a : OpenComparisons l E o c)
    (gamma : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
      (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
      (_h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i),
      Operations.push l E o r ⋙ Operations.shriek l E o i ⟶
        Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    (canonical : ∀ {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
      (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
      (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U),
      (gamma k r p i h).app M ≫
        (b.push l E p).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o k).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) p).map
          ((b.shriek l E k).hom.app M) =
      (b.shriek l E i).hom.app ((Operations.push l E o r).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) i).map
          ((b.push l E r).hom.app M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.gamma (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E)
          k r p i h).app M) :
  ∀ {A C E₀ B₀ D F : Scheme.{u}}
      (k : A ⟶ B₀) (i : C ⟶ D) (j : E₀ ⟶ F)
      (r₁ : A ⟶ C) (r₂ : C ⟶ E₀) (p₁ : B₀ ⟶ D) (p₂ : D ⟶ F)
      [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
      [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [QuasiCompact j]
      [IsProper r₁] [IsProper r₂] [IsProper p₁] [IsProper p₂]
      (h₁ : k ≫ p₁ = r₁ ≫ i) (h₂ : i ≫ p₂ = r₂ ≫ j)
      (h : k ≫ (p₁ ≫ p₂) = (r₁ ≫ r₂) ≫ j) (M : System l E A),
      (Operations.shriek l E o j).map ((c.pushComp l E r₁ r₂).hom.app M) ≫
          (gamma k (r₁ ≫ r₂) (p₁ ≫ p₂) j h).app M ≫
          (c.pushComp l E p₁ p₂).inv.app ((Operations.shriek l E o k).obj M) =
        (gamma i r₂ p₂ j h₂).app ((Operations.push l E o r₁).obj M) ≫
          (Operations.push l E o p₂).map ((gamma k r₁ p₁ i h₁).app M)

statement_change.old_statement: The vertical field of ProperOpenTransportPasting holds for the supplied proper/open gamma.
statement_change.what: STATEMENT-DISPUTED in the original: an arbitrary gamma has no pasting law. Even in an identity diagram the equation imposes idempotence after normalization; multiplying a nonzero canonical identity transformation by 2 fails it. The intended source constructs a bridge-conjugate gamma. Require precisely its canonical bridge equation, supplied by the existing ProperOpenTransportCore.canonical; no target or existence-theorem hypothesis changes.
